result.topic_en: Solution of the heat equation du/dt = a^2 d^2u/dx^2 on an infinite line via a Fourier-type integral, evaluation of Gaussian integrals with a cosine or complex linear term (including a contour shift), and draft German text about particular versus general solutions of partial differential equations, apparently the opening of a letter to a professor.
